units.title: SG-1.4.2 · Render HeaderOverlay from App through the GameLayout header slot
Act: Add header slot prop to GameLayout
Act: Wire round loading/error state and HeaderOverlay into App
Act: Remove RoundBadge and Countdown usage from App
Verify: GameLayout header slot unit tests

tests.id: layout.test.tsx > GameLayout header slot > header inside main
tests.name: Given a header node, when GameLayout renders, then the header sits inside the main region alongside the scene
tests.title: header is rendered inside the main region alongside the scene
tests.scenario: Given a header node, when GameLayout renders, then the header sits inside the main region alongside the scene
tests.detail: screen.getByTestId('hdr').closest('main') is non-null and contains the scene node

tests.id: layout.test.tsx > GameLayout header slot > no header
tests.name: Given no header node, when GameLayout renders, then the Story button and scene node still render
tests.title: Story button and scene still render when no header is given
tests.scenario: Given no header node, when GameLayout renders, then the Story button and scene node still render
tests.detail: Story button and scene-node are in the document without a header

units.title: Verify: App header round states unit tests

tests.name: Given the round resolves, when Begin is clicked, then the header shows the round id and status
tests.title: App header round states > shows the round id and status when the round resolves
tests.scenario: Given getCurrentRound resolves with an open round, When Begin is clicked, Then the header shows 'round-1' and 'OPEN'

tests.name: Given the round never resolves, when Begin is clicked, then the header shows the loading message
tests.title: App header round states > shows the loading message while the round is pending
tests.scenario: Given getCurrentRound never resolves, When Begin is clicked, Then the header shows 'Loading round…'

tests.name: Given the round request rejects with an error, when Begin is clicked, then the header shows an alert with the error message
tests.title: App header round states > shows an alert with the cause when the round request fails
tests.scenario: Given getCurrentRound rejects with Error('boom'), When Begin is clicked, Then role alert has text 'Round unavailable: boom'

tests.name: Given the App is rendered, when Begin is clicked, then the header shows the world title
tests.title: App header round states > shows the world title in the header
tests.scenario: Given getCurrentRound resolves, When Begin is clicked, Then the header shows "The Boy's Room"

units.title: Verify: No standalone RoundBadge or Countdown in App unit tests

tests.id: appNoLegacyRound.test.tsx > App legacy round UI removed > Given an open round, when the player begins, then the round status renders exactly once inside the header
tests.name: Given an open round, when the player begins, then the round status renders exactly once inside the header
tests.title: App legacy round UI removed: round status renders exactly once inside the header
tests.scenario: Given the current round is OPEN; When the player clicks Begin; Then getAllByText('OPEN') has length 1 and its closest('header') is non-null
tests.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/appNoLegacyRound.test.tsx --testTimeout=20000

tests.id: appNoLegacyRound.test.tsx > App legacy round UI removed > Given the App source, when it is read from disk, then it does not reference a standalone RoundBadge or Countdown
tests.name: Given the App source, when it is read from disk, then it does not reference a standalone RoundBadge or Countdown
tests.title: App legacy round UI removed: App source has no RoundBadge or Countdown reference
tests.scenario: Given the App.tsx source file; When it is read with node:fs; Then it does not match /RoundBadge|Countdown/
tests.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/appNoLegacyRound.test.tsx --testTimeout=20000
